versions.changelog:
Initial release of markitdown-convert.

- Provides a CLI tool to convert PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, and images to Markdown.
- Uses the markitdown library for all conversions.
- Mandatory for all Markdown conversion scenarios; manual scripting or alternative tools are prohibited.
- Supports batch and automated workflows.
- Installation via pip with markitdown[all] dependency.
